title: A blank description or number never reaches the save
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • No other data is needed: the window is opened empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type three spaces in Description.
  3. Type three spaces in Part Number.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the window itself refuses the save: "Description is a required field" shows under Description and "Part number is a required field" under Part Number, and nothing is saved.
  • Step 6: when a blank description or part number reaches the system some other way than this window, other than the parts import, the system refuses it with a red message "Description is required." or "Part number is required." that goes away after about 3 seconds. This part cannot be checked by hand; write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-N6, S7-N1, S7-N2, S7-N7, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Save with nothing filled), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 3). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-N1: “Description is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Description is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • S7-N2: “Part Number is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Part number is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • S7-N6: “If an empty description or part number reaches the system by any other route, the save is refused with "Description is required." or "Part number is required."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Empty description reaches the system by another route): “"Description is required." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Empty part number reaches the system by another route): “"Part number is required." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • S7-N7: “S7-N3 to S7-N6 do not apply to the parts CSV import. An import row whose number matches a part already stocked at this location updates that part (S13-N9a). It is never refused for a duplicate number.”
